collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DEPARTURES AND EXILE (DEP-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Leaving and being left: moving huts, short journeys, visitors going home, goodbyes done well and badly, homesickness, and the rare person who sails away for good. Choosing to leave is never a rejection of one's people, and choosing to stay is never a failure.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult or elder)

collection.description: A villager who has never been on a long journey stops at the stone travelers touch for luck: touch it anyway, or leave it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: On the path out of the village there is a smooth grey stone, and anyone setting out on a long journey touches it for luck. The top is polished shiny by generations of hands. (name1) has walked past it every day of (his/her) life and never touched it, because (he/she) has never been on a long journey. Today, walking past, (he/she) stops.

choices.label: Leave It for Someone Who's Going

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (name1) puts a hand on the stone. It's warm from the sun. Nothing happens. (He/she) isn't going anywhere. But it feels like joining something, all the same: everyone who ever left and everyone who came home. (He/she) walks on, a little lighter, to the gardens.

o1__text.text: (name1) puts a hand on the stone. It's warm from the sun. Nothing happens. (He/she) isn't going anywhere. But it feels like joining something, all the same: everyone who ever left and everyone who came home. (He/she) walks on, a little lighter, to the gardens.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (name1) takes (his/her) hand back. That stone is for leaving. (He/she) isn't leaving. (He/she) likes it here. (He/she) walks on to the gardens and works all morning, and feels perfectly content, and doesn't think about the stone again until the next time (he/she) walks past it, which is tomorrow.
